title: kernel-v1 final verdict (v1)
description: Aggregate verdict across every evidence row referenced from the reviewer reports. The schema requires the reviewer chain to bind itself to a concrete commit and to every evidence path it consulted, so a reviewer cannot claim PASS without listing the artifacts it inspected.

schema_version.description: Bumped on backward-incompatible shape changes. Currently always 1.

plan.description: Repo-relative path to the approved Prometheus plan that owns this verdict.

verdict.description: Aggregate verdict. 'pass' iff every reviewer's verdict is 'approve' AND gate_pass_fail is true. 'fail' otherwise. 'inconclusive' is reserved for cases where evidence is insufficient to decide.

commit.description: 40-char hex Git commit hash the verdict applies to.

evidence_paths.description: Every evidence file the verdict depends on, in repo-relative form. A reviewer MUST list every artifact that influenced the verdict; missing files are a defect.

reviewers.description: Independent reviewer records. Each row binds the reviewer to a role, verdict, and the review document path so the chain is auditable.

name.description: Reviewer identifier (person, agent, or CI job).

verdict.description: Per-reviewer verdict. 'approve' iff the reviewer endorses the aggregate verdict; 'reject' otherwise; 'abstain' iff the reviewer defers to another reviewer.

review_doc.description: Repo-relative path to the reviewer's review document (typically <attemptDir>/task-F<n>-*.json|.html).

gate_pass_fail.description: True iff every gate from quality:all, plan:audit, scope:check, and qa:e2e is green. False otherwise. 'pass' is forbidden when this is false.
